subject: Privacy & Digital Rights
title: The Premera Blue Cross Breach
description: A quick, practical guide to The Premera Blue Cross Breach.

hook.text: Hackers accessed 11 million health insurance records including medical claims and bank account numbers.

buildup.text: Premera Blue Cross stored detailed patient records — diagnoses, treatments, and financial information.

discovery.text: The breach began in May 2014 but wasn't discovered until January 2015 — nine months of silent access.

twist.text: Medical data combined with financial records is a goldmine for identity thieves and insurance fraudsters.

climax.text: Eleven million patients had their most sensitive records exposed — and most never knew for nine months.

punchline.text: Nine months of access. Eleven million records stolen.

quiz.question: How long did hackers have access to Premera Blue Cross systems?
